title: No Signs of Hacking in FAA Ground Stop as FBI Reportedly Probes Software Update
description: A nationwide FAA ground stop occurred due to a communications problem at air route traffic control centers, likely caused by a software update overwhelming legacy equipment. Officials, including Homeland Security and the FBI, found no evidence of a cyberattack. The outage lasted over four hours and disrupted thousands of flights, with delays expected to continue. The FAA was applying patches and installing new technology, which may have triggered the failure. No official root cause has been announced, and investigations continue.
